title: Independent broad-IPA review queue for 삶의
purpose: Queue the exact Korean form 삶의 for independent source-blind broad-IPA annotation. Official surface evidence is held by the coordinator and must not be shown before first-pass annotations are submitted.
acceptanceCriteria: Two qualified Korean phonetics reviewers independently annotate broad IPA without seeing source citations, surface comparators, engine outputs, candidate IPA, Ukrainian targets, or the other reviewer's annotation.
Record syllable boundaries, vowel-length assessment, method reference, qualification, reviewer identity, timestamp, and uncertainty.
Reconcile differences only after both independent submissions are complete.
Review Ukrainian adaptation separately after IPA is frozen.

cases.sourceLocator: NIKL MCFAQ 5716 reports Hangul surface variants [살믜] and [살메] for particle 의; this metadata is withheld from reviewer packets.
cases.notes: No IPA candidate supplied; reviewers must adjudicate independently.
